research_topic: Catastrophic Forgetting Prevention with Theoretical Guarantees in Continual Learning Develop Theoretical Guaranteed Selective Memory Preservation (TG-SMP) using Fisher Information Matrix-based dynamic parameter selection to achieve 30% improvement in average accuracy retention and Backward Transfer (BWT from -15% to -5%) on Split-CIFAR100 (20 tasks), Permuted-MNIST, and Core50 datasets, compared against EWC, PackNet, Progressive Neural Networks, and GEM baselines.
